proposals.evidence: Full būṭa subsection 3 bōṭṭa explicitly gives West Pahari boṭṭ and Kumaoni/Nepali boṭ tree/stem/trunk. The selected Danuwar and Kului boṭ/botːe/botːiː tree forms match this o-vowel branch. Source gemination, vowels and inflection remain intact, with local development and cross-IA transmission qualified. Exact response: botːe.
